rules.rule: AUTHORIZATION_CHANGE, SUSPENSION, REVOCATION, or AUTHORITY_RESTORATION requires authorization_state_change
RESTART cannot carry a RESUMPTION_* restart/resumption decision or top-level disposition; RESUMPTION cannot carry RESTART_* values
rules.source: field 22 semantics and controlled disposition families

rules.rule: RESTART_* or RESUMPTION_* disposition requires restart_resumption_decision
Profile materiality activation is external governance context and must not be inferred from mere field presence or ordinary telemetry. Validator may receive activated profile IDs separately.
